name: LineChart
description: Customisable time-series line chart built on `lightweight-charts`, with built-in zoom, tooltip, and legend. Data is passed via props; the component does no fetching

props.name: chartRef
props.description: Mutable ref to hold the LightWeightCharts reference

props.name: data
props.description: Data of the chart

props.name: yTicksFormatter
props.description: Callback to format ticks on y axis. If `priceFormatter` is given. It would be used instead

props.name: customLabel
props.description: Name shown in the tooltip row of a series that has no `label`; a dataset's own `label` wins

props.name: priceFormatter
props.description: Callback to format ticks on y axis

props.name: roundPrecision
props.description: The number of decimals to show

props.name: priceFormat
props.description: Y-axis step and decimals. The default `minMove` of `0.01` leaves a series that moves less than that (e.g. 0.942 to 0.94…
props.descriptionFull: Y-axis step and decimals. The default `minMove` of `0.01` leaves a series that moves less than that (e.g. 0.942 to 0.945) with no y-axis labels; set e.g. `{ minMove: 0.001 }`

props.name: timeline
props.description: Bucket interval of the data (`1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `3h`, `1D`; case-sensitive). Sets how many of the latest points are vis…
props.descriptionFull: Bucket interval of the data (`1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `3h`, `1D`; case-sensitive). Sets how many of the latest points are visible on load or when it changes (15, 12, 12, 12, 14; 24 for any other key) while `shouldResetZoom` is on. Without it the whole series fits

props.name: fixedTimezone
props.description: IANA time zone (e.g. `Europe/Berlin`) whose offset is added to every timestamp, so the default UTC axis labels read as…
props.descriptionFull: IANA time zone (e.g. `Europe/Berlin`) whose offset is added to every timestamp, so the default UTC axis labels read as that zone's wall-clock time

props.name: shouldResetZoom
props.description: Wether to Reset Zoom

props.name: skipRound
props.description: Prevent rounding of values

props.name: skipMinWidth
props.description: Do not enforce a min width

props.name: fadedBackground
props.description: Use a faded background

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color of the chart

props.name: customDateFormat
props.description: `date-fns` format for axis and crosshair time labels, rendered in the browser's local time zone. Without it, labels are…
props.descriptionFull: `date-fns` format for axis and crosshair time labels, rendered in the browser's local time zone. Without it, labels are in UTC

props.name: verticalLineLabelVisible
props.description: Show vertical line at mouse position

props.name: horizontalLineLabelVisible
props.description: Show horizontal line at mouse position

props.name: showDateInTooltip
props.description: Show date line in tooltip

props.name: disableAutoRange
props.description: Disable automatically determining range

props.name: uniformDistribution
props.description: Changes horizontal scale marks generation. With this flag equal to true, marks of the same weight are either all drawn…
props.descriptionFull: Changes horizontal scale marks generation. With this flag equal to true, marks of the same weight are either all drawn or none are drawn at all

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit to display with values

props.name: beginAtZero
props.description: Starts the value axis at 0. A series whose values are all `>= 0` never gets a negative axis in any case, including one…
props.descriptionFull: Starts the value axis at 0. A series whose values are all `>= 0` never gets a negative axis in any case, including one sitting flat at 0

props.name: showPointMarkers
props.description: Show a marker on the line

props.name: height
props.description: Controls the height of the chart

fields.name: datasets
fields.description: One line series per entry; `visible: false` hides a series without removing it

fields.name: minMove
fields.description: Smallest step between y values and axis ticks. Defaults to `0.01`

fields.name: precision
fields.description: Decimals shown. Derived from `minMove` when unset
